title: sorbus americana subsp. japonica
intro: Sorbus americana subsp. japonica, commonly known as Japanese Mountain Ash, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, where it is used to treat various health issues due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as lowering cholesterol levels and reducing the risk of cardiovascular diseases. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
